annotations.title: Start checkout at a GYSM shop

description: Create a secure Stripe checkout link for products from one GYSM store. Only call it after the shopper has confirmed the items and quantities. The shopper opens the link and pays on Stripe's page; nothing is charged by this tool. Prices come from the store, not from the request.
name: start_checkout
